Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased toto issue a Writ, order or direction,
especially one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring the inaction of respondents in paying LA/NHAI/Award No. 13A/2018 Panapakam(V)/Chandragiri(M), dt 25-7-2018 for an extent of 40.47 Sq Mrts in S.No 821/4A, of Panapakam Village, Chandragiri Mandal, Chittoor District as illegal, arbitrary, violative of Articles 14, 21 and 300- A and Right to Fair Compensation and Pasam Nagarjamma vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16668872/
1 Transparency in.

Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, National High Ways Act, 1956 and consequently direct the respondents to pay compensation as fixed by the 3rd respondent stated supra for an extent of 40.47 Sq Mrts in S.No 821/4A, of Panapakam Village,

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Chandragiri Mandal, Chittoor District

and pass IA NO: 1 OF 2022 Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct respondents to consider the representations, dt 9- 2-2019, 23-8-2021 and 7-22022 by paying compensation as per the proceedings of the 3"1 respondent, dt 25-7-2018 in respect of land to an, extent of 40.47 Sq Mrts in S.No 821/4A, of Panapakam Village, Chandragiri Mandal, Chittoor District, pending disposal of the above Writ Petition and pass IA NO: 2 OF 2022 Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased pleased to implead the 5th respondent i.e National High way of authorities in W.P.No.8668 of 2022 and pass Counsel for the Petitioner:
1. T V JAGGI REDDY Counsel for the Respondent(S):
1. GP FOR REVENUE 2. GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION 3.
S S VARMA (SC FOR NHAI)

The Court made the following Order:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned Assistant Government Pleader for the respondent Nos.1 to 3 and the learned Standing Counsel for the 5th respondent.
2. The learned Standing Counsel for the 5th respondent relying upon the written instructions dated 25.10.2025 submits that the award was passed on 29.06.2018 and that the compensation amount was already deposited on 27.10.2018.
3.
In view of the same, the petitioner is at liberty to approach the authorities concerned for withdrawal of the same without furnishing any security.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
The written instructions of the 5th respondent dated 25.10.2025 shall be made as part of the court record.
Interim order if any, deemed to have been vacated.
There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel, Miscellaneous Petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
_________________________ JUSTICE B KRISHNA MOHAN 05.11.2025 NNN Pasam Nagarjamma vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16668872/
